equityFacts: [FACT — Hero equity vs the modeled villain range(s), computed on-device by Monte Carlo (10000 trials), NOT by you: pre-flop ~59%, flop ~35%, turn ~18%, river ~14%. The modeled villain ranges already include a GTO-balanced share of bluffs, so this is hero's true bluff-catch equity — compare it directly to any pot-odds price FACT (whether labelled "Price for hero to call" or "Price hero was getting when he folded") to decide call vs fold. [FACT — Villain MrWhite (BTN) range behind the equity above: Pre-flop: called a middle-position open → BTN defending range (~6% of hands) · tightened ×0.6 for reads; Flop: bet (~50% pot) → polarized: top 21% value + bottom 5% bluffs; Turn: bet (~50% pot) → polarized: top 21% value + bottom 7% bluffs; River: check → range unchanged.]

[HEURISTIC — Equity REALIZATION (raw equity discounted for hero's position + hand class; ESTIMATED, not exact): flop ~35% → realized ~39% (OOP, a strong made hand); turn ~18% → realized ~20% (OOP, a strong made hand); river ~14% → realized ~16% (OOP, a strong made hand). A marginal hand out of position rarely realizes its raw equity; a strong made hand over-realizes. Weigh the continue / bluff-catch read against the REALIZED figure, not the raw one — but this is heuristic context: a decisive pot-odds price FACT and the hard equity FACT above still take precedence.]

[HEURISTIC — SPR & COMMITMENT (effective stack ÷ pot, hero-centric; ESTIMATED, not exact): flop SPR ~16.3 — to get all-in profitably needs ~49% equity (high SPR — favours pot control with one-pair hands); turn SPR ~7.9 — to get all-in profitably needs ~47% equity (high SPR — favours pot control with one-pair hands); river SPR ~3.7 — to get all-in profitably needs ~44% equity (medium SPR — strength-dependent). The stack-off % is the equity to get all-in profitably versus a willing range, NOT hero's pot-odds price.
